title: D4b: build the PR-029 reconciliation-cost KPI, which has been ratified and unbuilt
description: Operator ruled YES on D4 (2026-08-17). PR-029 defines a reconciliation-cost KPI with an operator baseline of roughly three months of human effort, and it has never been built, so rung 11 has records and no instrument. Build it. It measures what repairing a divergence costs over time, which is a different question from the Implementation Gap the valley measures at an instant. Follow the currency.py precedent exactly on the hard part: if PR-029 defines no failing point, emit NO THRESHOLD RATIFIED and no verdict, because a tool that invents a threshold has decided the question. Report every count twice, raw and distinct, per the event_stats.py provenance rule.

notes.note:
HANDOFF -> verifier: T-403 (D4b) DONE by coordinator-opus, handing to a DISTINCT verifier. The finding is that this
KPI's correct output today is a REFUSAL, and the record says so itself.

1. WHAT PR-029 ACTUALLY SAYS, READ VERBATIM BEFORE ANYTHING WAS BUILT

Its `dicta` are EMPTY, so every clause is ratio and binds under SDR-01. Clause 6, quoted in
its own casing:

  "The metric is measurable only once two domain registries exist; until then it is recorded
   as not yet measurable with that reason, never as zero."

Its validity_conditions say the same from the other side: "only one domain registry exists, so
this metric is defined but not yet measurable".

SO CLAUSE 6 IS AN INSTRUCTION TO REFUSE, and it is the entire shape of the tool. One domain
registry exists. .harness/bin/westphalia_kpi.py reports NOT YET MEASURABLE plus the reason and
emits NO cost figure at all.

2. WHY A ZERO WOULD NOT BE A ROUNDING ERROR BUT A TIER-1 VIOLATION WITH TEETH

A KPI reading zero reads as "divergence repair is free". That is clause 5's FIRST BRANCH, which
concludes Part C's containment architecture is over-engineered and SHOULD BE SIMPLIFIED. So a
fabricated zero does not merely mislead: it argues for dismantling the containment layer on the
strength of a measurement nobody took. That reasoning is in the docstring and in the refusal
text, because "why not just print 0" is the obvious next question and tidiness is not the
answer.

3. NO THRESHOLD RATIFIED, FOR A REASON WORTH CHECKING

Clause 5 gives a DIRECTION -- toward negligible, or stays expensive -- and names no failing
point, no units for "negligible", and no comparison basis against the 3-month baseline. So no
verdict is emitted, following currency.py: emit the figure, refuse the verdict. One test asserts
the status string carries no pass/fail/healthy token. Another asserts that if a NUMBER ever
appears in clause 5 the test FAILS, because NO THRESHOLD RATIFIED stops being true at that
moment.

4. THE TWO CONFLATIONS THAT WOULD MANUFACTURE A FIGURE, BOTH GUARDED

(a) ZERO MEASUREMENTS IS NOT ZERO COST. measurements_raw counts how many times the cost was
    measured. It is 0, and that is a TRUE and useful count. The cost is None. Clause 6
    legislates against precisely this conflation.

(b) THE DEFINITION OF "DOMAIN REGISTRY" IS THE TOOL'S, NOT THE RECORD'S. PR-029 does not define
    the term. The tool counts a directory of numbered immutable records with its own id prefix
    -- today precedents/ and nothing else -- and LABELS that as its own operationalization,
    printed on every run.

    WHY IT IS PRINTED, and this is the part to attack: that definition is the switch deciding
    whether clause 6's refusal applies at all. Widening it is a CHEAPER route to a "measurable"
    KPI than building a second registry. So it must stay visible enough to argue with. A test
    adds a second registry with a different prefix and asserts the precondition does NOT flip.
    That is the test that fails first if someone widens the definition to fake measurability.

5. THE REFUSAL IS A CONDITION, NOT A HARDCODED CONSTANT

A tool that always refused would pass every test in sections 1-4 while being useless.
WhenTwoRegistriesExist monkeypatches the definition so it recognises two and asserts the status
DOES flip -- and that the cost is STILL None, because clause 3 requires wall-clock hours PLUS
tokens and wall-clock is not instrumented. Meeting the precondition does not manufacture a
measurement.

6. THE INSTRUMENTATION GAP, REPORTED RATHER THAN DROPPED

  TOKENS      PARTIAL. usage_report.py harvests the runner's transcripts. It is a harvester,
              not a counter this harness writes; the cache split must be read before raw tokens
              are treated as cost.
  WALL-CLOCK  NOT INSTRUMENTED AT ALL. The harness writes no duration counters. Clause 3
              requires hours PLUS tokens, so even with two registries this measure would be
              HALF-BLIND.

That last line matters for planning: closing the registry precondition does NOT make the KPI
work. Someone will need to instrument duration. The coordinator did not file that as a task, on
the grounds that it is premature while the precondition is unmet. Disagree if that is wrong.

7. STRUCTURAL GUARDS, PARSED AND NOT SCANNED

Four AST tests, because a substring scan is wrong here for the reason on this project's register
five times over (GUARD-MENTION-C): the module's prose repeatedly discusses zero, cost and
thresholds, and a scan cannot tell prose from an assignment.
  - no assignment ever puts a number in out["cost"];
  - no arithmetic anywhere over a name containing hour, token or cost;
  - the module calls none of the filesystem-mutating methods -- read-only enforced structurally,
    because a KPI that can write is a KPI that can record a measurement nobody took;
  - the docstring quotes the ratio it leans on.

The measurement store is NOT created on read, deliberately: a tool that made its own empty store
would make "the store is empty" indistinguishable from "the store was never set up".

8. A CORRECTION MADE MID-BUILD, worth noting for what it was about

The first docstring set clause 6 IN CAPITALS for emphasis. That alters quoted ratio text. Small
in itself, except this module's whole subject is not misquoting records, and the coordinator has
four tier-1 miscitations on file from today. The quote now sits in its own casing with emphasis
outside the quotation marks, and a test catches a regression.

9. EVIDENCE, REPLAYABLE

  python3 .harness/bin/westphalia_kpi.py
      -> KPI PR-029 -- NOT YET MEASURABLE
         registros de dominio   1 crudos / 1 distintos  (se requieren 2)
         mediciones en archivo  0 crudas / 0 distintas  (se requieren 3 para revisar)
         costo                  NO EMITIDO
  python3 -m pytest .harness/tests/test_westphalia_kpi.py -q   -> 28 passed
  python3 -m pytest .harness/tests/ -q                          -> 640 passed, 4 skipped

SIX NEGATIVE CONTROLS, each in a COPY of .harness, never the live tree:
  A cost set to {hours:0, tokens:0}           -> 5 fail (incl. the AST guard)
  B a pass/fail verdict emitted               -> 6 fail
  C the clause-6 reason stripped out          -> 1 fail
  D the definition passed off as the record's -> 2 fail
  E the store created on read                 -> 2 fail
  F arithmetic on tokens introduced           -> 1 fail

10. ALSO PINNED: IF PR-029 IS AMENDED, THIS TOOL BREAKS LOUDLY

Four tests read the live PR-029 and assert clause 6 still forbids zero, still requires two
registries, that dicta are still EMPTY (which is WHY every clause binds), and that clause 5
still carries no number. If the record changes these fail rather than letting the tool keep
refusing on a ratio that no longer reads that way. The coupling is intentional; check it is
coupled to the right four things.

11. A THIRD REPRODUCTION OF T-407 HAPPENED WHILE FILING THIS NOTE

The data-loss guard blocked the first attempt to write this handoff, because section 7 listed
the filesystem-mutating method names the AST test forbids. Third occurrence today: once on the
act body, once on T-406's own filing, once here. Every one of the three was prose DESCRIBING a
removal that was not being performed. T-407 already has the first two; add this one.

12. NO LIVE WRITE. Read-only tool, read-only run. Consistent with T-401 and T-402 and for the
reason in T-400 section 6.
